commentary_summary: The Handysize vessel utilization improved last week from 92.2% to 92.6%, reaching close to last year's level. The utilisation trend continues to be volatile every week, with the speed of the vessels following the trend to respond to the changing demand. | Meanwhile, the tonnemile index moderated WoW. As China's hydropower generation has picked up, its coal demand has moderated MoM despite being elevated. As China imports thermal coal from Russia's Far East ports in Handysize vessels, the vessel demand is impacted as trade tapers. | The ballast tonnage at China's load ports has dropped significantly, indicating tepid coastal trade. Meanwhile, the laden tonnage at anchor in China, waiting to unload at discharge ports, has peaked for 2024 and is seasonally higher compared to last year.
